notes.title: Patch notes - Wigged Out August Update
notes.notes:
Two brand new levels are added to Wigged Out, Bypass Buffer and Dingy Divide!
Dingy Divide
This Campus area level is divided down the middle by two hedges with a walkway in between. You can only get the ball through by moving it along the sides or sending it airborne over the hedges. But be aware of the goat, it will chase you if you get too close!
Bypass Buffer
Use the flippers located at each goal to give the big ball an extra momentum and try to avoid hitting the bumpers, as they will knock the big ball all over the place! But if you’re a big fan of randomness and chaos, this level also comes in a second variation, with even more bumpers!

notes.title: Patch notes - Wigged Out Summer Update
notes.notes:
A brand new content update for Wigged Out is now available, and this time we’re adding two new levels, a new wig and a new hat!
New Levels
In the spirit of the summer season we’re adding two new Golf themed Country Side levels this time

Country Clubbing

This level takes place at a fancy high-end country club, and comes in three different variations, each with their own hazard configurations

Rock n Roll

Located deep in the forest, surrounded by mountains and rivers, this golf themed level requires precision and timing to get the ball past the moving fences and into the goal. And for some added chaos, you can release the big rolling stones by pulling the levers!
New Unlockables
Two new unlockables are also added, each with their own unlock challenges

Top Braid(Wig) - Give your head that extra breathing room during hot summer days by tying up all that hair into one long, stylish braid

Cap(Hat) - Protect your eyes from the sun with this practical cap, a must-have for those sunny days out on the course!

notes.title: Patch notes - Wigged Out content update
notes.notes:
We just released a new update for Wigged Out, containing two exiting new levels, Fancy Fans and Wild Woodlands

Fancy Fans
Located in the Campus area, this (fan)tastic level comes in two unique variants!

Wild Woodlands
Hazardous mushrooms, poorly placed rakes, and a spinning goal—there’s a reason it’s called Wild Woodlands!

notes.title: Patch notes - With updated content!
notes.notes:
We’ve just dropped a fresh update packed with 4 brand-new levels and 3 stylish new unlockables, each with their own unique unlock challenge! Check out what’s new below

New levels:

Basic Bumps
If you want more unpredictability, this is the level for you. With big bumps, or shall we say small hills, all over the map, you have to stay focused at all times to predict where the big ball is going! 

Halfway House
In this level you have to navigate around a park area with a big fountain in it. But, if you look closely, you might notice a shortcut to reach the other side quickly! 

Hostile Half
Speaking of shortcuts, on this large level, using the shortcuts might be the difference between winning and losing! The same goes for using the flippers at the right moment! 

Bombastic Banana
A level shaped like a banana. That's it. That’s the description. Go play it.
New unlockables:

Bowl Cut (wig) – A throwback to the medieval era. Bold. Round. Beautiful?
Last Straw (wig) – It's straw. Sort of. Just try it.
Plant (hat) – Embrace the spring vibes with some leafy flair growing right from your head!

3 new challenges are now available for unlocking the new cosmetics!

Patch Notes Summary

Added Content

New Levels:

Basic Bumps
Halfway House
Hostile Half
Bombastic Banana
New Wigs:

Bowl Cut
Last Straw

New Hat:

Plant
Added Features

3 new challenges -  for unlocking new cosmetic items

Minor Fixes

Brad’s WigOut Power - Improved turn radius for smoother control

notes.title: Wigged Out Major Update
notes.notes:
Big changes are added to Wigged Out!
We’ve been hard at work tweaking, refining, and adding in new content to make the game even more chaotic and fun. This update brings new features, crucial fixes, and a whole lot of polish!
Some of the newest additions include two brand-new items—the Toilet and the Big Fish—ready to shake up the game! And for those who prefer to let their actions do the talking, we’ve added an emote system, so you can express yourself without saying a word.
We’ve also dedicated a lot of effort into improving online play, making matches smoother and more reliable than ever.
Thank you for your continued support—your feedback keeps us going! Now, let’s dive into the patch notes:

Patch Notes

Major Updates
Performance & Networking
Optimized the entire game, improving networking stability and reducing lag.
Camera optimizations across all scenes (no more multiple cameras active at once).
Goals are now properly synced for all clients.
New Features & Content
In-Game Emoji Feature: Added an emoji wheel for quick in-game expressions.
New Item – Toilet: Added a new in-game item with unique mechanics.
New Item – Fish: Added a new in-game item with unique mechanics.
New Item – Banana cluster: Added a new in-game item with unique mechanics.
Added rotation to character in collection menu


Localization & UI Overhaul
Full localization update, including better handling of language changes.
Fixed misaligned UI elements, such as "Local" and "Online" text overlaps.
Improved announcement texts and UI readability.
Fixed room code display issue when switching languages.
Critical Bug Fixes
Fixed softlock issues that could occur when pausing or entering menus.
Fixed players getting stuck in different situations.
Fixed unresponsive inputs when disconnecting/reconnecting controllers.
Improved matchmaking handling, reducing the chance of getting stuck in online rooms.

Minor Updates
Gameplay & Mechanics[/color]
Collision & Interaction Adjustments

Increased trigger rate for items like the lance.
New collision shape added for the lance.
Better collision checks for Jock ult.
Fans no longer push players who have the “NoKnock” effect active.
Clients can now predict interactions with placed items/hazards, reducing lag in physics-based interactions.
Spawning & Character Behavior

Fixed player spawning issues: Only player one spawns when returning to the main menu.
Lucy’s Dog now correctly spawns on the ground instead of falling through.
Fixed rotation of George in collection.
Fixed an issue where characters were hiding when changing levels.
Balance Adjustments

Increased collision check rate for Brad’s ultimate ability.
Adjusted item and ability balancing.
Rotating goal is now easier to score on from both sides.
Visual & UI Enhancements
Collection & Trophy Scene Improvements

Added new collection arrows for better UI navigation.
Characters now rotate properly in the collection menu.
Smoother, less laggy trophy scene.
Less “deep-fried” trophy images & improved camera angles.
General UI Fixes

Removed button focus from “Create” game button; now defaults to "Join".
Fixed UI alignment on multiple screens.
Menu animations improved.
Fixed spacing in text & announcement popups.
Added auto-changing glyphs on the intro screen based on platform.
Other Visual Fixes

New particle effects for fountains.
Updated aim decals for Banans, Wig Keg, and the Toilet item.
Fixed clipping issues with characters in collection mode.
Fixed camera optimization in all scenes.
Removed camera shake from Big Ball when affected by “Taps.”
Bug Fixes
Controller & Input Fixes

Fixed controller disconnect issues in online matches.
Fixed unresponsive controls when disconnecting controller at specific times.
Game now properly pauses when opening Steam overlay.
Online & Matchmaking Fixes

Fixed room code updating when changing language.
Players no longer get stuck if they fail to join a room.
Clients now see a 'Waiting for Host' notification when the host is deciding on match settings.
Teams are no longer considered balanced if all players are on one team.
Animation Fixes

Fixed animation pop issues when changing wigs with Jock.
Fixed animation issues in tutorial (Coach animations).
Fixed wig-related animation bugs.
Miscellaneous

Fixed issue where achievements weren’t saving/loading properly.
Fixed floating props in some levels.
Removed redundant logs that were spamming the console.

notes.title: WIGGED OUT - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
-Tutorial:

The camera now persistently focuses on Brad when using the Wigout Power.

Users cannot pause during the WigOut initiation.

-Gameplay:

The ranged wig no longer becomes unusable when bouncing off certain objects.

Players can throw the wig, hitting reported items without losing it afterwards.

-Softlock Fix:

Players can now return to the Main Menu Room after joining an online match, then a local match.

-Pause Menu Optimization:

The Wigout Power no longer loads quickly when the pause menu is opened, preventing the WiggedOut Meter from increasing.

-Animations:

Fixed an issue where entering the Pause Menu during Charles/Lucy/Brad's Wigout Power animation caused a modification in skill. Users can no longer pause during the WigOut state.

-Locker Room Control:

Second players in online matches can now control their WigOut Power display in the Locker Room.

notes.title: WIGGED OUT - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Changes in EA Version 0.1.0027:

Tutorial:

Bush Collision Fix: The character no longer gets stuck on top of bush collision in the first level of the tutorial.

In-Game:

UFO Behavior Adjustment: The UFO now functions properly even if the player stands directly underneath it before the abduction light turns on.

Sophia’s Sound Wave Fix: Sophia’s Sound Wave is no longer affected by the air current from fans.

General:

Bug Fixes and Improvements: Various fixes and enhancements have been implemented to ensure smoother gameplay experience.

notes.title: WIGGED OUT - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
-Lobby:
Improved Visibility:
"Add Bot" and "Remove Bot" text relocated inside empty portrait frames for better visibility.
Online Room Code Menu Fix:
Each option now has its own button prompt for clarity: "A" to Accept and "B" to Go Back.


-In-Game:
Melee Wigs Persistence:
Resolved issue where Melee Wigs would disappear after first use as a client.

Teleporter Item Fix:
Teleporter item can now be removed from one player to another as expected.

Fan Mechanics Adjustment:
Fans only exert force when there is air present, preventing constant pushing.

Hazards Behavior Fix:
Fire Hydrant and Manhole hazards now correctly push and stun characters upon contact.


-Purple Passing Level (Country Side):
Bridge Accessibility:
Characters can now walk across the bridge in Purple Passing level instead of being obstructed.


-Tutorials:
Text Correction:
All tutorial texts have been reviewed and corrected for accuracy.


-Settings:
Option Menu Improvement:
Audio and video settings no longer slide up slowly in the Game Options menu.


-Wigs:
Afro Wig Unlock Issue:
Afro wig unlocking issue has been resolved.


-General:
Mouse Cursor Lock:
Mouse cursor now stays locked within the game window during fullscreen mode to prevent accidental clicks outside the game.

notes.title: Wigged Out! | Open Beta - Update Patch
notes.notes:
Open Beta version V3 (v0.1.1007) has been released, with all these improvements:
🐐 Ranged items can now be hit in closer range.
🐐 Our characters have updated dodging animations.
🐐 Items collection has been fixed so you can get all the collectibles you've earned.
changed number 7 to be easily differentiated with number 1 with the game's font system.
🐐 Brad's WigOut ability can now be much better controlled.
🐐 Improved items interactions so you pick up items as soon as you walk over them.
🐐 In online play with codes, the save data of host players and client players is now synchronised.
🐐 Fixed unresponsiveness in the third and fifth tutorial levels.
🐐 Fixed unresponsiveness when a pause coincides with a match countdown (showing the yearbook pages)
🐐 Bots fixed in Pinball levels so they work as they should.

🏐 As always, let us know any bugs you find or add any ideas you think would be hair-raising in the game's Community Hub.🏐

Thanks for continuing to support Wigged Out!
